thread:
marta: Heads-up: temporary tweak to the release train next week. Read and react if you own deploys or migrations. :loud_sound:

leo: what's changing?

marta: Two changes: 1) deploy lanes become Tue (canary) / Fri (ramp) for 2-week pilot. 2) short "maintenance freeze" Thu 22:00-23:30 UTC - only emergency hotfixes allowed. No schema/model migrations during freeze unless approved by leads.

ops-bot: Ticket created: MT-4609 "Pilot: Tue/Fri deploy lanes + Thu maintenance freeze" (owner: leo).

qa-nia: QA schedule question: will canary still be Tue 09:00 UTC? I need to book regression windows.

marta: Yes, canary Tue 09:00 UTC. For this pilot, please run smoke + golden-path regressions within 2 hours after canary pass. I'll post checklist.

infra-rene: For infra: we'll block database DDLs during Thu freeze. Any migration planned for Thu should be moved to Fri 03:00 UTC (post-ramp) or get explicit sign-off.

leo: I'll push a small change to the canary job to add a cache-warm phase and a health-check gate. snippet:

```yaml
steps:
  - name: cache-warm
    action: run
    cmd: scripts/warm_cache.sh --max-conn 50 --timeout 1200
  - name: canary-deploy
    action: deploy
  - name: canary-health-gate
    action: check
    cmd: scripts/health_gate.sh --endpoint /healthz --threshold 0.995
```

pm-zara: Any customer-impact notes? Support should we post an FYI?

marta: No outages expected. If a hotfix is needed during the freeze, patching timeline will be delayed to next window unless it's P0. I'll draft a short note for #support and #customers to set expectations.

qa-nia: ack. I'll move our regression slot and update test-grid.

leo: Also enabling branch protect for Tue/Fri merges starting next cycle.

ops-bot: Reminder: branch protections scheduled.

marta: Thanks everyone. If you have cross-team blockers, add them here. We'll review pilot at end of next week and decide whether to continue.
